mapper.sql: tenant_id, id, owner_user_id, client_attachment_id, input_sha256, object_key, media_type, byte_size, width, height, status, conversation_id, turn_no, created_at, expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(byte_size), 0) FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_attachment (tenant_id, id, owner_user_id, client_attachment_id, input_sha256, object_key, byte_size, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{id}, #{ownerUserId}, #{clientAttachmentId}, #{inputSha256}, #{objectKey}, #{byteSize}, #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, owner_user_id, client_attachment_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE batch.console_ai_attachment SET status = 'DRAFT', media_type = #{mediaType}, byte_size = #{byteSize}, width = #{width}, height = #{height} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'UPLOADING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND turn_no = #{turnNo} AND status = 'BOUND' ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_object_cleanup (tenant_id, object_key) SELECT tenant_id, object_key FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_object_cleanup (tenant_id, object_key) SELECT a.tenant_id, a.object_key FROM batch.console_ai_attachment a JOIN batch.console_ai_conversation c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.id = a.conversation_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.expires_at < #{now} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_object_cleanup (tenant_id, object_key) SELECT tenant_id, object_key FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('UPLOADING', 'DRAFT') AND expires_at < #{now} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_object_cleanup (tenant_id, object_key) SELECT tenant_id, object_key FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('UPLOADING', 'DRAFT') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('UPLOADING', 'DRAFT')
DELETE FROM batch.console_ai_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('UPLOADING', 'DRAFT') AND expires_at < #{now}
DELETE FROM batch.console_ai_object_cleanup WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND object_key = #{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE batch.console_ai_object_cleanup SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND object_key = #{key}
